start.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Out of Egypt
start.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Israel walks free at first light.
Which way will you lead them?

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Take the short road by the sea
[TODO:pt-BR] Follow the Lord's pillar of cloud
[TODO:pt-BR] Hurry back to beg Pharaoh's blessing

short_road_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Not That Way
short_road_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The Philistines guard that path.
The Lord leads another way.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Follow the Lord's pillar of cloud

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Do Not Turn Back
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Egypt is behind you forever.
Look only ahead.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Follow the Lord's pillar of cloud
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You set your face to the desert.

pillar_follows.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Pillar of Cloud
pillar_follows.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] By day a cloud, by night a fire.
The Lord goes before His people.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Press on as He leads you

pharaoh_regrets.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Pharaoh's Regret
pharaoh_regrets.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] In Egypt the king curses his weakness.
"Bring back our slaves!"

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Speed back to plead with him
[TODO:pt-BR] Trust the Lord and keep moving
[TODO:pt-BR] Hide the people in the dunes
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] There is no hiding from this.

plead_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] No More Pleading
plead_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] His chariots are already rolling.
The time for words is gone.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Trust the Lord and keep moving

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Sand Cannot Hide You
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Six hundred chariots can find you.
Only the Lord can save you.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Trust the Lord and keep moving

army_charges.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Dust on the Horizon
army_charges.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] A red cloud rises behind you.
Chariots. Hundreds of them.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Tell the people: do not fear
[TODO:pt-BR] Run with them toward the cliffs

run_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Stand Firm
run_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] There is nowhere left to run.
The Lord will fight for you.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Tell the people: do not fear

people_panic.title: [TODO:pt-BR] "Why Bring Us Here to Die?"
people_panic.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The people cry out, trembling.
"Were there no graves in Egypt?"

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Curse them for their unbelief
[TODO:pt-BR] Surrender the people to Pharaoh
[TODO:pt-BR] Speak peace: stand and see Him

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Speak Hope, Not Wrath
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] They are afraid. So were you once.
Lead them with His promise.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Speak peace: stand and see Him

surrender_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Never Back to Chains
surrender_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He did not free you to bind you.
Stand and trust His hand.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Speak peace: stand and see Him

moses_prays.title: [TODO:pt-BR] A Cry to Heaven
moses_prays.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You stand at the water's edge.
Only the Lord can open this.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Demand the people build boats
[TODO:pt-BR] Lift your staff over the sea
[TODO:pt-BR] Wait silently for some other sign

boats_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] No Boats Tonight
boats_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He needs no wood, no sails.
His breath is enough.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Lift your staff over the sea

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] He Has Spoken
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "Why do you cry to me? Go forward."
The sign is in your hand.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Lift your staff over the sea

sea_parts.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Waters Divide
sea_parts.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] A great wind splits the sea in two.
A dry road opens through it.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Send the people across at once
[TODO:pt-BR] Stand back and only watch
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] It opened so you could go.

watch_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Walk Through It
watch_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] His miracle is for crossing.
Lead them between the walls.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Send the people across at once
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You step onto the dry seabed.

crossing.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Between the Walls
crossing.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Walls of water rise on each side.
Israel walks the dry path.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Boast of your power before them
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] It is His arm, not yours.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Lead them toward the far shore

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] His Hand, Not Yours
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Give Him glory, not yourself.
Lead with a humble heart.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Lead them toward the far shore
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You bow your head and walk.

far_shore.title: [TODO:pt-BR] On the Far Shore
far_shore.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Israel stands safe. Behind you,
chariots crash into the corridor.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Mock the drowning soldiers
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Do not laugh at His judgment.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Run back to fight them yourself
[TODO:pt-BR] Stretch your hand back over the sea
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] The wind shifts at your hand.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Solemn, Not Proud
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] His judgment is heavy and just.
Receive it with awe.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Stretch your hand back over the sea

fight_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] He Fights for You
fight_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Do not lift a sword tonight.
Lift only your hand at His word.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Stretch your hand back over the sea

sea_closes.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Sea Returns
sea_closes.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The walls fall as one great wave.
Not one chariot rises again.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Sing to the Lord with the people

ending.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Saved by His Hand
ending.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Israel stands free on the shore.
The Lord alone has saved them.
